question_text: A foreign investor from Japan wants to buy a 10-hectare agricultural land in Davao for a resort development. Under Article XII of the 1987 Philippine Constitution, which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: The foreign investor may own the land outright because the Constitution allows foreign ownership of land for tourism purposes.
The foreign investor may own the land if he partners with a Filipino citizen who holds at least 60% equity.
The foreign investor cannot own the land because the Constitution limits land ownership to Filipino citizens or corporations with at least 60% Filipino ownership.
The foreign investor may lease the land for up to 99 years but cannot own it under any circumstance.
